items.body:
Thanks for spotting this. The link is on line 9 of [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): it points to `master/AI_POLICY.md`, and the default branch is `main`. Labelling this as a documentation issue.

Pull requests are limited to collaborators. Per [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md), contributors describe the change in an issue first, so this issue is the right place for it. A maintainer will review it.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
